rootCause: An exec/code-run tool invoked a script importing an uninstalled dependency; Python raised ModuleNotFoundError (a dependency/environment failure, classified by exit_code/stderr — NOT a misclassification).
hiddenMechanism: Whether this is already 1-call diagnosable via obs.diagnostics is the open question the gating table measures. The stderr carries the cause plainly — unlike the historical misclassification, the mechanism is NOT hidden, which is itself the finding.
